question: Can prioritizing horizontal COM support margin before loaded rise avoid an ideal geometric stall on the first and last retained R10AG loaded poses?
input_scope: All 110 retained loaded plans for source reconstruction and one-step feasibility; first and last loaded poses for bounded ideal propagation. AG's invalid physical attempt remains unchanged and consumed.

variants.horizontal_only: Center with 10 candidates: five original scales times two yaw-aligned horizontal directions; fixed torso height and orientation.
variants.coupled_translation: Center with 30 candidates: five original scales times two yaw-aligned horizontal directions times negative/zero/positive vertical movement; fixed torso orientation. Vertical movement can satisfy existing leg reach and joint bounds.

centering_metric: Minimum signed distance from modeled COM projection to convex-hull edge lines of all four modeled distal endpoints, in world XZ. Outside values are half-plane violations, not Euclidean distance or contact-force measurements.
model_design_margin: One authored foot radius, 0.04 * foot_radius_scale metres. This is a candidate planning parameter, never a replacement task threshold.
centering_selection: Strictly improve signed support margin; maximize that margin, then minimize absolute vertical displacement, then original geometry cost. Preserve first exact tie. No torso rotation during centering.
rise_selection: Once the model margin reaches one foot radius, select the lowest original geometry cost among original cost-decreasing candidates that retain this prospective COM margin.
preserved_bounds: Original 0.1 m/s virtual translation, five scales, both analytic IK branches, 4 rad/s and original joint limits, 0.5 mm maximum unactuated lateral residual. Maximum 600 mathematical updates per pose per variant; terminate visibly on no admissible plan.
assumptions: Perfect torso/joint tracking, all four native contacts assumed qualified, fixed torso-local COM. No dynamics, friction, contact force, physical task evaluation or causal inference.
checks: Reproduce all 110 original loaded plans before interpretation; six synthetic hull/selection controls; source/report bindings unchanged during execution; retain every variant and refusal, including failures.
